## Introduction

Mohawk API enables you to programmatically interact with Mohawk’s data. This allows us to simplify and streamline our operations while providing our clients and partners with real time visibility to the data in our systems. Our API follows modern RESTful conventions and speaks JSON in both directions.

**The following endpoints are in production. Details for each endpoint are included in this document:**

- Authentication
- Bookings
- Brokerage Data
- Brokerage Reporting
- Container Management
- Container Tracking
- Customs Status
- Documents
- Domestic Status Report
- EDI210 (Inland Freight Invoice from motor carrier)
- Events
- ISF Status
- Location Matrix: Estimated and Actual Dates of Container for Origin, Ports and Final Destination, including Rail sightings.
- Mohawk’s Invoice
- Purchase Orders
- Rail Events
- Shipment Details
- Tracking Callback Events
- WebHooks
- Quick Track (Does not require Authentication)

## Note:

All input for POST requests that are marked with \[FromBody\] must be JSON Serialized Objects, be UTF8 Encoded, and have their Media Type (Content Type) as “application/json” unless stated otherwise
